long_biography.plain_text:
Dimitris Procopiou's shipping career began as a partnership. He and his brother George established Sea Traders in 1974, expanding from an early bulk carrier into a mixed commercial fleet. When they separated their interests in the late 1980s, Dimitris took his share of the vessels and formed Centrofin as an independent family group.

Centrofin has since operated tankers and bulk carriers through specialist technical-management companies. Procopiou's approach has combined vessel operation with patient timing: after the global financial crisis, he acquired ships from failed German investment funds and later renewed the fleet with modern tonnage. This pattern of opportunistic purchasing, technical upkeep and selective renewal has kept the business active through repeated freight and asset-price cycles.

Procopiou's approach has combined vessel operation with patient timing: after the global financial crisis, he acquired ships from failed German investment funds and later renewed the fleet with modern tonnage.
